tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: Compute all major Hindu festivals (Ugadi, Holi, Diwali, Navratri, Ganesh Chaturthi, etc.) and the 12 solar sankrantis for one year, 2020-2040, sorted by date. tools.name: next_festival
tools.description: Find the first Hindu festival or sankranti falling on or after a given date (looks into the following year if needed; 2020-2040 only). Use for 'what is the next festival?' questions. Do NOT use for a list; use list_festivals or festivals_in_month.

tools.name: festival_details
tools.description: Look up one festival by name in a given year and return its computed date, lunar month, tithi and the rule behind it. tools.name: festivals_in_month
tools.description: List the Hindu festivals and sankrantis that fall in one calendar month of a year (2020-2040), sorted by date; may be empty. Use for questions like 'festivals in October 2026'. Do NOT use for the whole year (use list_festivals) or the next one (use next_festival).
